issues.where: crop P lower-left sunlit limb (also image-05.png and image-06.png crop G)
issues.what: a sharp, bright detached crescent floats several pixels outside Saturn's lower-left limb with a dark gap between it and the globe, forming an obvious doubled edge
issues.fix: align the atmospheric shell and inner-ring occlusion mask tightly with the planet sphere so no detached bright sliver forms outside the limb

issues.where: crops C and H on the lit A and B rings just right of Saturn's dark limb (also image-05.png and image-07.png crops M, R)
issues.what: a straight diagonal seam cuts across the lit rings; between this line and the nightside limb the ring bands and Cassini Division become blurred, smeared, and brighter than the adjacent sharp ring texture
issues.fix: eliminate the ring UV/tile or screen-space patch boundary and sample high-resolution ring detail continuously right up to the planet's limb

issues.where: crop W bottom-right outer ring edge inside Saturn's shadow (also image-01.png, image-05.png, and image-08.png crop W)
issues.what: an angular, straight-edged polygonal notch cuts into the shadowed outer rings exposing starry sky, with a clipped lit ring sliver protruding at the bottom edge of image-04.png crop W
issues.fix: fix the outer ring geometry bounds and shadow clipping so the ring edge follows a continuous smooth ellipse into shadow without angular cutouts

issues.where: crops W and X across the lower-right shadowed rings (also image-02.png crop E, image-06.png crop E, and image-08.png crops W, X)
issues.what: horizontal blue and amber streak artifacts and a bright blue smudge cross the shadowed rings and clip in a hard line along the outer boundary of the ring mesh in crop X
issues.fix: remove baked or ring-masked flare streaks from the ring shader and apply any optical glare in full-frame post-processing without clipping to the ring alpha

issues.where: crop P inner ring gap beside the lower-left sunlit limb (also image-02.png crop G, image-06.png crop G, and image-07.png crop P)
issues.what: the warm atmospheric limb glow drops in a hard curved step along the inner boundary of the translucent C/D ring plane instead of fading smoothly across the gap
issues.fix: composite atmospheric limb scattering continuously behind and through the inner ring alpha without stepping at the inner ring mesh edge

issues.where: crops K, L, M, P, and Q along sunlit planet/moon limbs and lower-right nightside globe edge (also image-02.png crops B, E and image-06.png/image-07.png equivalents)
issues.what: high-contrast sunlit limbs on Saturn and the upper-right moon show raw 1-pixel stair-stepping beneath the haze, and Saturn's dark lower-right limb has a sharp polygonal corner where it meets the ring shadow
issues.fix: increase sphere tessellation on Saturn and apply supersampling or anti-aliasing across planet, moon, and shadow edges

issues.where: crop M sky immediately surrounding the moon (also image-07.png crop M)
issues.what: a dark circular matte halo wider than the moon suppresses faint background stars around the disc, with an isolated bright pixel sitting just off the dark right limb in image-03.png
issues.fix: tighten the moon's alpha and atmosphere falloff so it does not punch an oversized dark cutout into the background starfield

issues.where: crops D, F, and I on the rings/Cassini Division and image-03.png crops J, K, L in the starfield (also image-06.png and image-07.png equivalents)
issues.what: background stars and Milky Way dust appear blocky at 1-2 pixel scale, and isolated single-pixel white pinpoints sit inside the Cassini Division and across dense lit ring bands
issues.fix: render stars with smooth sub-pixel point-spread profiles, suppress single-pixel shader fireflies on the rings, and attenuate background stars by physical ring optical depth

issues.where: crop J upper-left sky gradient and crop L blue north polar vortex (also image-01.png, image-05.png, and image-07.png crops J, L)
issues.what: the upper-left sky glow shows faint concentric 8-bit banding, and the blue polar vortex looks overly soft and airbrushed next to the crisp mid-latitude cloud curls
issues.fix: dither low-slope sky gradients to prevent banding and add fine-scale concentric cloud detail to the polar region to match mid-latitude sharpness

issues.where: near and mid ring plane; same dots in the ring tiles of image-10.png, image-11.png, and image-12.png
issues.what: soft round white dots sit on the ringlets like overlaid sprites, the same circular profile on bright and dark bands
issues.fix: remove the billboard pass, or replace it with sparse irregular grains that lie in the ring plane and shrink toward the far ansa

issues.what: the bands and eddies look airbrushed, with little fine convective texture
issues.fix: add finer shear and small-scale cloud texture so the painted look breaks up

issues.where: small moon above the north limb
issues.what: the disc is a smooth shaded bead with no haze rim outside the limb
issues.fix: add a thin brighter haze just outside the limb
